title: Chipmaker Broadcom is breaking out. How Tony Zhang is trading it - CNBC
snippet: Broadcom is growing AI semiconductor revenue at triple-digit rates, converting nearly half of revenue into free cash flow, and guiding to one of the steepest near-term revenue accelerations in the sector, yet the stock trades at a major discount to the semiconductor group. Broadcom's most recent quarter reinforced that this is not just a momentum trade. AI semiconductor revenue grew 143% year over year and management guided Q3 revenue up 84%, with AI semiconductor revenue expected to grow more than 200% year over year. Industry ~16.5% Broadcom trades at a deep discount to the semiconductor group despite materially stronger expected revenue growth, stronger EPS growth, and more than double the industry's profitability. Bullish Thesis AI Semiconductor Momentum Is Exploding: Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue grew 143% year over year in Q2, and management expects that growth rate to exceed 200% in Q3. With the breakout above $400 and the fundamentals supporting a move toward $500, the put spread provides a defined-risk way to establish a position and seek further upside if the breakout holds and momentum continues.
